info.title: Auctions / Remates proposed API
info.description: Design contract. Each instance serves one deployment-configured country, with no user or administrator selection. Country request overrides are rejected. Every user belongs to an organization, including a solo organization; all workspaces and subscriptions are organization-owned. No deployed service; all commercial and source decisions remain proposed. See docs/05-api-contract.md for cross-field rules and permission model.
